rule: design only; NO new solves this round; new BEM/nodes need separate authorization

route_A_trajectory_first.priority: preferred when an independently measured trajectory exists
pipeline: intensity averaged over exposure (average INTENSITY, never complex field)
constraints: unknown axial/orientation must NOT be filled with 0 and called measured
trajectory must not be back-derived from amplitudes of the same unknown D
minimal holdout: held-out time windows + control particle-free background
route_A_trajectory_first.admission_gate: all trajectory/scale/timebase items in physics_input_contract.json measured

route_B_field_first.priority: only when trajectory must be predicted from B(t)
pipeline: B(t) vector + gradient + waveform + camera sync
magnetics/hydrodynamics/contact boundary consistent with fixation state
predicted trajectory -> optical forward as route A
constraints: 200 Hz drive alone does NOT license a 400 Hz displacement assumption
minimal holdout: B-off control + independent B calibration
route_B_field_first.admission_gate: all B-field/boundary items in physics_input_contract.json measured
